title:
Loads all {@link Facility#id}s that a user can access and sets them in the application state.
The fields {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#allFacilities} and {@link ReliabilityApplicationState#selectedFacilities} are populated in application state.

The epic stores cached facility data in `localStorage` and uses it
to populate the application state if it is available. It still does a Facility fetch, and updates state
and `localStorage` if the cache is stale.

In addition to setting the fields in the application state, the `FACILITIES_LOADED`
action is fired to indicate that up to date facility data has been populated in the application state.
name: LoadDefaultFacilitiesEpic
